en: #0#$001Ron Weasley and his brothers, Fred and George, rescued Harry Potter from the misery of number four Privet Drive.  They flew him in a flying car to their home, the Burrow, where Harry met Mrs. Weasley.  Harry must now silence the noisy ghoul in the attic.
#3#$002After climbing into the attic, Harry managed to silence the noisy ghoul for Mrs. Weasley.  Harry and Ron must now find Mr. Weasley.

#6#$003While looking around, Harry bumped into a shy Ginny Weasley and her pet Puffskein. Later, after using Wingardium Leviosa to break up Arthur Weasley\u00b8s non-magical junk, Harry found the hidden de-gnoming gloves.  Harry must now de-gnome the Burrow\u00b8s garden.
#9#$004Using the de-gnoming gloves given to him by Mr. Weasley, Harry successfully de-gnomed the Burrow's garden.  Harry must now compete in his first Wizard Duel against Fred Weasley.
#C#$005Having beaten Fred Weasley at Wizard duelling, Harry and Ron split up to search for the missing Ginny Weasley.

#F#$006Harry found Ginny and she gave him her Remembrall. Harry, along with the Weasleys, must now make his way to Diagon Alley using Floo Powder to collect his books and other school things he needs for his second year at Hogwarts.

#12#$007In Borgin and Burkes, Harry spied on Lucius and Draco Malfoy.  Later, in Flourish and Blotts, Harry met his new Defence Against the Dark Arts teacher, Gilderoy Lockhart. For some reason, he and Ron couldn\u00b8t get on to Platform Nine and Three quarters, so they decided to drive the flying car to Hogwarts.

#15#$008Harry and Ron eventually made it safely to Hogwarts \u00b5 or so they thought!  Unfortunately, they landed within reach of the Whomping Willow.  Harry must rescue Ron from the Whomping Willow and get into school before their absence is noticed.

#18#$009After escaping from the Whomping Willow, Harry and Ron noticed an empty chair at the Sorting ceremony.  The chair belonged to Professor Snape, who, after catching them and taking them to his office, ordered them to the Gryffindor Common Room.

#1B#$010Because they\u00b8d missed the Sorting ceremony, Harry and Ron hadn\u00b8t been told this year\u00b8s password for the Gryffindor Common Room.  They went off to find Hermione Granger in the Library.  Hermione told them the new password and now Harry and Ron must return to the Common Room.

#1E#$011After meeting Fred and George Weasley again in the Common Room, along with an awe-struck Colin Creevey, Harry must go outside into the grounds and make his way to the first Herbology lesson of the term.
#21#$012After leaving the Common Room, Harry must follow the other students and find his way to the first Herbology lesson of the term.
#24#$013Harry made it to the Herbology Lesson on time and now has to achieve a passing grade in the Incendio Duo spell lesson with Professor Sprout.
#27#$014Harry learned Incendio Duo in his first Herbology lesson and collected several mandrakes for Professor Sprout.
#2A#$015Harry received owl post from Oliver Wood inviting him to Quidditch Practice at the Quidditch Training Ground.  Harry must find his way there as soon as he can.
#2D#$016Harry successfully earned his wings in Quidditch Training with Oliver Wood.
#30#$017After Quidditch Training, Ron challenged Harry to a wizard duel.

#33#$018Draco Malfoy called Hermione a \u00b7filthy Mudblood\u00b8 and when Ron tried to cast a spell on Malfoy, his wand backfired and he ended up spewing slugs.  Harry followed Ron as he ran to Hagrid\u00b8s Hut to get help. They must find Hagrid to stop Ron spewing slugs.
#36#$019Inside Hagrid\u00b8s Hut, Harry managed to catch the slugs in Fang\u00b8s bowl.  Harry and Ron have to get back to the Gryffindor Common Room to meet Hermione.

#39#$020After meeting Ron and Hermione at the Common Room, the three friends made their way to the Defence Against the Dark Arts Lesson.  This year, the teacher was the famous Gilderoy Lockhart.  Now Harry has to make sure he gets to the lesson on time.
#3C#$021After getting to Defence Against the Dark Arts on time, Harry must now learn the Petrificus Totalus spell from Gilderoy Lockhart.
#3F#$022Harry attended his first Defence Against the Dark Arts lesson with Gilderoy Lockhart, where he learned Petrificus Totalus and battled with Cornish Pixies.

#42#$023Outside the Defence Against the Dark Arts classroom, Harry, Ron and Hermione met Nearly Headless Nick, who invited them to his Deathday Party.  Harry must find his way to the Dungeon, following Nearly Headless Nick.
#45#$024Harry followed Nearly Headless Nick through the Dungeons to his Deathday Party.

#48#$025Harry met Nearly Headless Nick and attended his Deathday party.  Afterwards, Harry stumbled across Filch\u00b8s cat, Mrs Norris, who had been mysteriously petrified.  Daubed on the wall was a chilling message warning that the Chamber of Secrets had been opened.

#4B#$026In the library, Hermione explained about the Polyjuice Potion and how this would enable them to sneak into the Slytherin Common Room.  Harry and Ron were tasked with finding the Polyjuice ingredients.  But first they had to attend Snape\u00b8s Potion class

#4E#$027After Potions Class, taught by Professor Snape, Harry and Ron were taught how to mix the Wiggenweld Potion. Harry bumped into Hagrid, who asked for his help in clearing his Halloween pumpkins from an infestation of gnomes.

#51#$028Harry helped Hagrid by de-gnoming his pumpkin patch and Hagrid rewarded Harry with one of the ingredients for the Polyjuice Potion.  Then it was time for Harry\u00b8s first Quidditch match against Slytherin.
#54#$029After helping Hagrid de-gnome his pumpkin patch and getting one of the Polyjuice Potion ingredients as a reward, Harry needs to take on Slytherin in this year\u00b8s first Quidditch match.

#57#$030Harry played Quidditch against Slytherin and during the match a rogue Bludger broke his arm.  Harry ended up in the Hospital Wing.  That night, Harry discovered Colin Creevey had also been petrified.  When he was better, Harry met Hagrid in Diagon Alley to get what he needed for the Polyjuice Potion.
#5A#$031In Diagon Alley, at the Magical Menagerie, Harry successfully caught the lacewing flies he needed for the Polyjuice Potion.

#5D#$032In Diagon Alley, Harry gained the lacewing flies he needed for the Polyjuice Potion.  At the Apothecary he got rid of an infestation of Cornish Pixies and received some leeches in return.  Harry and Hagrid headed back to Hogwarts.

#60#$033Harry and Ron gave Hermione the ingredients for the Polyjuice Potion, but they were still missing some vital ingredients.  Hermione sent them to get some hairs from Crabbe and Goyle to add to the potion.  Ron told Harry he\u00b8d meet him back at the Common Room.

#63#$034While looking for the hairs from Crabbe and Goyle to add to the Polyjuice Potion, Harry and Ron both ended up outside the Great Hall, where the newly started Wizard Duelling Club was holding its first meeting.

#66#$035When Harry duelled Draco Malfoy at the Wizard Duelling Club, Malfoy cast the Serpensortia spell and a black snake exploded from his wand.  The snake tried to attack another student, but Harry stopped it by shouting something in Parseltongue. Dumbledore told Harry he didn\u00b8t think he was the attacker.

#69#$036Once all the Polyjuice Potion ingredients had been collected,  Hermione was able to mix the potion and Ron and Harry changed into Crabbe and Goyle.  Harry and Ron need to follow a Slytherin student to find the Slytherin Common Room.
#6C#$037Harry and Ron both raced to the Slytherin Common Room, where Harry discovered that Draco Malfoy was not the Heir of Slytherin.

#6F#$038Returning to the Girls\u00b8 Bathroom, Moaning Myrtle gave Harry the diary. Harry received a message from Professor Lockhart asking him to come immediately to his office for his Defence Against the Dark Arts lesson.

#72#$039Harry learned Verdimillious Duo from Gilderoy Lockhart.  As he left Lockhart\u00b8s office, he was set upon by Lockhart's card-carrying cupids, who were delivering Valentine\u00b8s cards.  Harry must avoid being caught by the card-carrying cupids.

#75#$040After seeing the young Hagrid in Tom Riddle\u00b8s Diary, Harry and Ron decided they should go and see Hagrid. However, following the latest attacks, the teachers are patrolling the grounds.  Harry will have to use the Invisibility Cloak to sneak outside to Hagrid\u00b8s Hut.

#78#$041Harry used the Invisibility Cloak to sneak outside to Hagrid\u00b8s Hut.  While he was there, Harry saw Hagrid being led away to Azkaban.  Harry must now take Hagrid\u00b8s advice and follow the spiders into the Forbidden Forest.

#7B#$042Harry, following Hagrid\u00b8s advice, was following the spiders through the Forbidden Forest.  Harry must find out if Hagrid really was the person who opened the Chamber of Secrets 50 years ago

#7E#$043Harry followed the spiders into the Forbidden Forest and spoke with Aragog.  Harry, discovered that Hagrid wasn\u00b8t the Heir of Slytherin.  Harry and Ron escaped from Aragog in the Ford Anglia and must now pay a visit to Hermione in the Hospital Wing.

#81#$044Ginny went missing and Harry found a page torn from a book in Hermione\u00b8s petrified hand.  This told him about the basilisk and Harry realised he must find Lockhart to convince him to help rescue Ginny from the Chamber of Secrets.

#84#$045Ron and Harry found Gilderoy Lockhart busy packing his things to leave Hogwarts.  They persuaded him that he should stay and help them find Ginny, and told him they thought the way into the Chamber of Secrets was in the Girls\u00b8 Bathroom,

#87#$046In the Girls\u00b8 Bathroom, Myrtle told Harry where the entrance to the Chamber was.  Harry, Ron and Gilderoy Lockhart prepared to enter the large pipe that was exposed when Harry spoke Parseltongue.

#8A#$047After finding the entrance to the Chamber of Secrets in the Girls\u00b8 Bathroom, and opening the door using Parseltongue, Harry, Lockhart and Ron arrived in the tunnel beneath the school.  Now they must try and find Ginny.

#8D#$048Once inside the Corridor of Secrets, Harry managed to beat Lockhart in a duel and disarm him, but the force of the duel caused the ceiling to collapse, cutting Harry off from Ron.  Harry must carry on to the Chamber of Secrets to rescue Ginny.
#90#$049Harry managed to make his way through the Corridor of Secrets beneath the school and entered the Chamber of Secrets.
#93#$050Inside the Chamber of Secrets, Tom Riddle revealed himself as Lord Voldemort.  Riddle commanded the basilisk to attack Harry.
